mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 4% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained increase in industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained increase in federal funds rate above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied from UNRATE and PAYEMS) above 62.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS jointly imply labor force participation > 62.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained increase in labor force participation above 62.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1.2 million units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained decline in housing starts below 1.2 million units (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for three consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained increase in CPI above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
